infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Root listens only after you tap the mic, to hear the word you say. Nothing is saved.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Root turns what you say into a word so you can practice out loud. Nothing is saved.

plugins.microphonePermission: Root listens only after you tap the mic, to hear the word you say. Nothing is saved.
plugins.speechRecognitionPermission: Root turns what you say into a word so you can practice out loud. Nothing is saved.

plugins.motionPermission: Root uses motion to let you roll a marble and write letters in the air. Nothing is recorded.
